name: llm_usage_overview
description: Query LLM usage statistics from z-agent-llm-gateway. Returns total call count, input/output token counts, and estimated cost. Use this to monitor LLM spending, audit AI usage per app/user, or detect abnormal consumption. Can filter by appCode, userId, or accessKey. Daily trend data is also available via the /usage/trend endpoint (not covered by this skill; use llm_usage_overview for summary).

appCode.description: Filter by application code. e.g. 'ceo-agent' for all CEO agent LLM calls.

accessKey.description: Filter by access key (alternative to userId). The LLM gateway records usage per access key.
